costs.assumptions: Binance retail taker fee 0.10%/side (assumption); half-spread from the live order book; slippage = max(1 bp, book-walk impact for $1,000 beyond half-spread).

evidence_for.reading: z = +0.07, strongest of 27 coins; LightGBM regression, 15 leaves, strong regularization.

evidence_neutral.reading: -0.23% over 10 min; large moves tend to partly revert

data.opportunity_label: NO - expected move is smaller than estimated round-trip costs; spot action = stay in cash
data.probability_status: Calibrated on walk-forward out-of-sample backtest forecasts of this exact model; NOT yet validated on forward data (forward calibration is reported on the dashboard as outcomes accumulate).

rules.flat: Direction is scored against the last Binance trade at or before the expiry instant versus the reference trade price. If the two prices are identical the outcome is FLAT and counts as an INCORRECT direction for both UP and DOWN forecasts (rule fixed before testing).
rules.verification: Last Binance aggTrade at or before expiry_ms (same pair).
